question: Shri SL Bhyrappa received Padma Bhushan in the year 2023 for distinguished service of high order in which field?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Literature and education**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Shri SL Bhyrappa was awarded the Padma Bhushan in 2023.
 
• The award was given for his distinguished service of high order in the field of Literature and Education.
 
• Padma Bhushan is the third-highest civilian award in India.
 
• It recognises distinguished service of a high order to the nation, in any field.
